component.name: PortScope
component.summary: Inspect local ports, processes, systemd services and journal logs

description.p: PortScope answers a focused question: which local TCP/UDP endpoints are listening, which process owns each one, which systemd unit that process belongs to, and what the journal says about it.

ul.li: List IPv4 and IPv6 TCP/UDP endpoints with owner process, user and unit.
Show the evidence behind every endpoint-to-service link.
Read bounded journal logs for a selected unit.
Copy a diagnostic summary that excludes full command lines.
English and Simplified Chinese, light and dark themes.

description.p: PortScope runs entirely as the invoking user. It does not request root, modify groups, open the network, or send telemetry. Some information, such as the system journal, may be unavailable depending on your permissions; PortScope says so explicitly rather than showing an empty result.
Development snapshot. Core collection, evidence-based association, the three views, journal display, localisation and settings are implemented. Packaging and distribution verification are pending.
